metadata.title: Substrate Science & Engineering: Type 1 Foundations
metadata.notes: Hard-science depth for the planetary engineering tracks.

nodes.title: Advanced Carbon-Negative Materials
nodes.description: Beyond recycling. Synthesizing structural polymers, graphene, and bio-ceramics from atmospheric carbon and local regolith. Linked to the Foundry platform.

nodes.title: Synthetic Biology for Stewards
nodes.description: Engineering life for remediation. Principles of CRISPR and metabolic engineering applied to microbial heavy-metal sequestration and nutrient production.

nodes.title: Applied Information Theory
nodes.description: Entropy, channel capacity, and the limits of the mesh. Error correction algorithms for noisy LoRa links and the physics of semantic density in HDC.

nodes.title: Molecular Recycling & Depolymerization
nodes.description: The chemistry of the Detritivore. Breaking down complex polymers into their monomeric constituents using enzymatic and thermal catalysis.

edges.rationale: Mechanical sorting is the foundation for molecular depolymerization.
Synthesizing new materials requires mastery of molecular constituents.
General microbiology is the prerequisite for synthetic biological engineering.
Hyperdimensional computing is an application of high-density information theory.
